name: Apollo South Pipeline

values.StartLocation: Rover Pipeline interconnect, southern Wood County
values.EndLocation: Apollo Power Generation Facility, Middleton Township, near Bowling Green
values.DataCenterNotes: The data center is Meta's campus in Middleton Township, Wood County, Ohio, near Bowling Green. A Cleanview profile says Meta owns it through a subsidiary called Liames LLC, under the code name Project Accordion. The campus is 715,000 square feet on 280 acres, with an investment of more than 800 million dollars, and it has been under construction since October 2024. Williams is building the Apollo power plant next to it, 350 MW of gas generation plus battery storage, owned through Will-Power OH LLC under a 10 year power purchase agreement with Meta. The Ohio Power Siting Board approved the plant on February 3, 2026 without a public hearing. Targets are the first 150 MW of generation in July 2027 and the full 350 MW in August 2027. A Bowling Green Independent Media report from July 2026 says Meta is the plant's only power customer and that the Apollo South Pipeline from the Rover Pipeline will fuel it, with construction targeted for September 2026. The February 2026 approval described gas supply as two 16-inch pipelines.

researcher_notes: No existing row matches. The Rover Pipeline rows are the connecting line, not this lateral. A July 2026 Bowling Green Independent Media report says Williams is installing the Apollo South Pipeline, a 20-inch high-pressure gas line from the Rover Pipeline in southern Wood County, Ohio to the power plant on Mercer Road in Middleton Township. The plant's only power customer is Meta, which ties the line to its data center. Construction was planned to start in September 2026. The Williams project page for the Apollo project lists an Apollo South Pipeline and an Apollo North Pipeline as separate filings, which supports the name and the sponsor. Williams filed the Ohio Power Siting Board notice under case 26-0624-GA-BLN, according to the earlier candidate notes; that case number was not confirmed on the pages read. Length was not found in any source read. The Ohio case record was not reachable, so length is left blank, not guessed. Status is proposed because no source read confirms that construction has begun. The Apollo North Pipeline (case 26-0275-GA-BLN) is a separate line and was not researched here. Owner is the Williams subsidiary named in the filing, written in the ownership team's style. Route not researched; no route is available.
